title: docs: Switch the WSUG and WSDG back to using wiki.wireshark.org
description:
Switch the wireshark-wiki-url attribute to point to
wiki.wireshark.org again. Make the few cases in the WSUG and
WSUG that don't use that attribute use it.

Also switch README.dissector

Ping #17999
